honestDescription: The model does NOT receive unchanged pixels. It receives the same approved source image, followed by its required frozen model-native transform: RGB conversion, an intrinsic bicubic resize to 32x128, tensor conversion, and normalization with mean 0.5 and standard deviation 0.5. The intrinsic resize is a property of the model, not a preprocessing choice made by this probe.
recordedPerInvocation: transformed tensor sha256 (deterministic: computed over the contiguous float32 buffer)
